content:
zoe: Report from a user: upgrading to SDK v2 broke their Vercel Edge deploy with `TypeError: require is not defined`. They also get TS overload errors when calling createClient().
ken: Probably ESM/CJS mismatch + typings regressions. Do they have `type: "module"` and still use `require()` in quickstart?
arjun: Yep. Their examples had mixed imports. Edge workers are ESM-only, so `require` will blow up.
mei: For runtime we should ensure our package.json exports both entries: `"exports": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }`. Also publish an `esm` build that users can import explicitly for Edge.\oie: For TS: the error was `TS2769: No overload matches this call.` They were calling `createClient()` with no args after upgrading. Our current overloads require either a model or specific options which kills inference.
ken: We should add a single ergonomic signature: `function createClient<T = any>(opts?: ClientOptions & { model?: T }): Client<T>`. That keeps defaults friendly. Add a `createStrictClient` for strict inference if needed.
arjun: Regarding `unknown` vs `any`: internal libs can use `unknown`, but public exports should have ergonomic aliases: `type SDKResponse<T = any> = ResponsePayload<T>` and helper `parseResponse<T = any>(r: SDKResponse<T>): T`. That prevents forcing consumers into awkward casts.
mei: Edge docs: warn about top-level `process.env` reads and `Buffer` usage. Use guards: `const key = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env.API_KEY : (globalThis as any).__REDWOOD_API_KEY;` and avoid sync fs in examples.\en: Also prepare a minimal repro example `examples/edge-vercel-minimal` that imports the ESM entry: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/esm'` with package.json `type: "module"` and tsconfig: `{ "compilerOptions": { "target": "ES2020", "module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "esModuleInterop": true } }`.
ken: Add CI: run a small tsserver matrix (TS 4.9, 5.0, 5.1) against multiple tsconfig variants to catch these overload regressions early. Also add a lint rule forbidding `require(` in `examples/edge-*`.
zoe: I'll draft a PR that: 1) adds the ergonomic createClient overload, 2) exports `SDKResponse<T = any>` alias + parse helper, 3) adds the ESM entry and minimal example, 4) documents tsconfig/package.json snippets and runtime guards.
arjun: Small note: avoid evaluating `process.env` at module scope in the SDK. Read env lazily to avoid bundlers inlining undefined and causing runtime errors in Edge.
mei: Good catch. Also check for indirect deps that reference `Buffer` or `process` and add safe fallbacks.
zoe: Will create a tracking issue and link the PR when ready. @devex-bot create issue "sdk: ESM/CJS parity + TS overload ergonomics (Edge repro)"
devex-bot: Created issue #3412: "sdk: ESM/CJS parity + TS overload ergonomics (Edge repro)" and linked this thread.
ken: Thanks — once PR lands update the migration guide and quickstart snippets.
zoe: Will do. Planning to ship the PR tomorrow.
